lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune must be in want of a wife.

lines.speaker: mrs_bennet
lines.text: My dear Mr. Bennet, have you heard that Netherfield Park is let at last?

lines.speaker: mr_bennet
lines.text: You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it.

lines.speaker: mrs_bennet
lines.text: Why, my dear, you must know, Mrs. Long says that Netherfield is taken by a young man of large fortune from the north of England!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dreadful to me was the coming home in the raw twilight, with nipped fingers and toes, and a heart saddened by the chidings of Bessie, the nurse.

lines.speaker: john_reed
lines.text: You have no business to take our books; you are a dependent, mama says; you have no money; you ought to beg, and not to live here with gentlemen's children like us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: I did not see him lift the book, but I saw him in act to hurl it, and I instinctively started aside with a cry of alarm.

lines.speaker: jane
lines.text: Wicked and cruel boy! You are like a murderer, you are like a slave-driver, you are like the Roman emperors!
